headline: Empty seed: author prompt.md + task_template.md from scratch. Nine prose edits across eight clusters, led by the literal-value grading contract (26/28 failing traces write a formula the grader reads as None), plus a dedicated adversarial regression pass that caught and fixed five would-be regressions in my own first draft.

clusters.name: Formula written instead of value
clusters.detail: Grader is openpyxl.load_workbook(data_only=True) with SPREADSHEETBENCH_REWARD_RECALC=0. openpyxl stores formula text with no cached value, so the cell reads back None and scores 0 even when the formula is correct. The instruction itself usually asks for 'a formula', which actively misleads the agent. 26 of 28 failing traces do this; 0 of 12 passing traces do.

clusters.name: Cached values destroyed by round-trip
clusters.detail: A plain load_workbook(path) followed by save() blanks the cached values of formula cells the agent never touched. Cells inside answer_position fail without the agent editing them. Measured hazard: 267-18 1/2 cells, 48620 4/6, 7902 16/28.

clusters.name: No readback before declaring done
clusters.detail: 16 of 28 failing tasks are logic-right / artifact-wrong: they pass under recalc and fail under no_recalc. Nothing forced the agent to look at what it saved, and the baseline task template said 'once that file exists, you are done', explicitly licensing an early stop.

clusters.name: answer_position treated as a quota, and deletion not recognised as a write
clusters.detail: answer_position is a bounding box, not a fill target: _localize_failure measures gold filling under a quarter of the span on 90/912 tasks and under 60% on 203. Writing 0 or a placeholder into a blank answer cell fails. The mirror-image error is also real: where gold is blank but the input holds a value, clearing to None IS the answer (deletion / removal / de-duplication tasks).

clusters.name: Value-matching semantics unknown
clusters.detail: transform_value/compare_cell_value in evaluation.py: numbers rounded to 2dp, int equals float, numeric strings coerced, text compared case- and whitespace-exact, type(v1)==type(v2) required otherwise, datetimes converted to a day float (so time-of-day must be stripped and number_format is irrelevant), percentages stored as 0.05, None equivalent to empty string, formatting never compared.

clusters.name: Float-threshold off-by-epsilon
clusters.detail: 100 * 1.10 == 110.00000000000001, so a literal 'value >= ref * 1.10' misses a threshold that is exactly met. Proven on 51-12: naive comparison selects 2 rows, gold has 4.

clusters.name: Excel emulation instead of Python
clusters.detail: Agent tries to reproduce Excel semantics rather than writing the loop. Dynamic-array functions (UNIQUE, FILTER, TEXTSPLIT, TEXTJOIN, SEQUENCE) and array formulas are the worst case because openpyxl can store no value for them at all.

clusters.name: Preview trusted as a specification
clusters.detail: spreadsheet_content is only PREVIEW_ROWS=5 rows. The real header row, data extent and relevant sheet often differ, producing row/column offset errors.

edits.title: State the grading contract verbatim: compute in Python, store the literal value — even when the instruction asks for a formula, function or VBA
edits.verified: 6 of 6 tested failing tasks flip to compare_workbooks==True with literal values (12864, 59196, 56563, 46897, 48588, 48620). Control: fullCalcOnLoad changes nothing under REWARD_RECALC=0. Safety: 0 of 12 passing traces write a formula into the answer range; 9726 did via raw XML and was re-run as a plain literal datetime write -> True.

edits.title: Load with data_only=True so untouched formula cells keep the cached value the grader reads
edits.verified: Cached values preserved on all three hazard tasks (267-18 1/2, 48620 4/6, 7902 16/28) vs 0 under a default load. Not a cheat: a pure data_only round-trip with no edits passes ZERO failing tasks. Safety: answer-range readback identical under both loads on 8 of 12 passing tasks; the 4 that differ re-graded True under data_only=True (382-10, 9726, 402-43, 395-36).

edits.title: Mandatory verify round that writes no file, with a readback snippet and a checklist compared against the computed answer; delete the baseline's 'once that file exists, you are done'
edits.verified: Targets the 16 logic-right/artifact-wrong tasks: the readback prints exactly what the grader will read, so a None from a stored formula is visible before the agent stops. Deliberately not a coverage quota — a fill-the-box checklist measurably breaks 142-12 (gold 45/75), 560-12 (8/12) and 227-40 (17/20). Writing no file keeps _artifact_stamp from replaying the verify block as solution_code. MAX_TURNS is env-set to 30, so the extra rounds are free.

edits.title: Three-way blank rule: store the value, leave a blank blank, and clear an input value to None where the answer is blank; never invent a placeholder
edits.verified: 37378: blank -> True, writing 0 -> False. 382-10: write-nothing -> False, clearing the 13 non-Comments cells -> True. 227-40 without de-duplication -> False. Explicitly licensing a harmless same-value rewrite protects 463-17 / 47798 / 48527, which clear and recompute pre-filled example cells.

edits.title: Transcribe the comparator's value-matching rules, including the date-component carve-out (day/month/year/weekday/count store a plain int)
edits.verified: 31628: B1=int 10 -> True, B1=datetime -> False (the carve-out is what protects it). 9726: datetime(2016,6,12) -> True, with a time-of-day -> False, so the time-stripping rule is load-bearing. 416-15 re-run with and without number_format -> 0 mismatches both ways. Same value with different fill/font/number_format -> True (colour checks are commented out in cell_level_compare).

edits.title: Compare floats with an epsilon when a ratio or percentage threshold decides an outcome
edits.verified: 51-12: naive v >= ref*1.10 selects 2 rows -> False; v >= ref*1.1 - 1e-9 selects 4 = gold -> True. Strictly widens the accepted set at the 9th decimal; no passing task sits on such a boundary.

edits.title: Prefer a plain Python loop over emulating Excel; name the dynamic-array functions as the worst case
edits.verified: All 12 passing traces already solve in Python, so this endorses existing passing behaviour rather than changing it. Also covers the error-string skip (#N/A, #NUM!, #REF!, #DIV/0! arrive as str) and the ws.max_row overstatement.

edits.title: Inspect-first round; relabel spreadsheet_content as a five-row hint, not a specification
edits.verified: MAX_TURNS is env-set to 30, so the 4 one-block passing tasks (31628, 47798, 48527, 560-12) go from 1 to 3 rounds with 27 to spare. No passing task depends on answering from the preview alone.

edits.title: Create the sheet named in answer_position when it does not exist; scope the first-sheet default to answer_position values with no '!' at all
edits.verified: Regression fix found by the adversarial pass. cell_level_compare returns (False, 'worksheet not found') when the named sheet is absent. 402-43 with no Sheet2 created -> False; create_sheet('Sheet2') + values -> True. 395-36 create_sheet('MyResult') -> True.

edits.title: Calibrate only on worked examples OUTSIDE answer_position; a pre-filled graded cell is a hint and the instruction wins
edits.verified: Regression fix. 9726's only graded cell J2 is pre-filled with a stale cached 2016-05-14 while gold is 2016-06-12. Measured: leaving J2 -> False, correct literal -> True. The first draft's 'the file beats your interpretation' rule and its 'any worked-example cell you changed' checklist item both pointed at the failing action.

edits.title: Soften 'spend no effort on formatting' so an explicit formatting instruction is still obeyed
edits.verified: Formatting is genuinely never compared (verified), but 560-12's own instruction demands left alignment. Skipping it still passes, yet the agent should not have to decide it may disobey its instruction. Now: no effort for its own sake; if asked explicitly, apply it in a line or two and move on.

skipped.title: Formatting fidelity
skipped.reason: Fills, fonts, number formats, column widths and filters are all uncompared; the fill- and font-colour checks in cell_level_compare are commented out. The prompt tells the agent to stop spending effort there instead of teaching it to do it better.

skipped.title: Multi-case replay / solution_code robustness
skipped.reason: _artifact_stamp replays the last output-changing code block onto cases 2 and 3, but the verified-400 dataset ships one case per task (_case_indices returns a single index), so replay is inert here. Kept the 'verify round writes no file' rule as cheap insurance and spent no prose on it.

skipped.title: keep_links=False as a standing load default
skipped.reason: 463-17 loads in 0.00s under all four kwarg combinations, so it was not load-bearing. Demoted to one clause of the error-recovery advice.

skipped.title: Any per-task literal
skipped.reason: No task id, sheet name, target cell or expected answer appears in either file. Every rule is stated over a class of inputs, per the non-overfitting constraint.

skipped.title: Any prose workaround for an environment fault
skipped.reason: There is no environment fault. All 40 traces were checked for infra signatures: zero permission, gateway, timeout or missing-binary errors, and no traceback except one task's own buggy code.

techniques: tighten output contract (quote the grader's own call verbatim)
add omitted rule (data_only=True load; create missing sheet)
remove a harmful instruction (deleted 'once that file exists, you are done')
restructure into an ordered procedure with a mandatory no-write verify round
positive rewrite of the blank/bounding-box rule into a three-way decision rule
add worked examples (float epsilon, value-type pairs)
soften over-strong wording (formatting; first-sheet fallback; preview as hint)
adversarial regression pass: a separately-scoped read-only subagent briefed only to find instructions that would make a PASSING agent behave differently
empirical verification of every rule through the official compare_workbooks against real gold files, with a wrong-reading/right-reading pair per rule
adapter-validated placeholder contract (_task_template_error plus a full .format render)
